ValidationRule.description: Freight - After an Opportunity is Closed, you may only edit the Closure Information section
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND($RecordType.DeveloperName = "Freight", NOT (ISNEW()) , NOT( CONTAINS($User.Profile_Name__c, "Administrator")),
OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( StageName) , "Closed - Accepted"),ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed - Accepted')), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( StageName) , "Closed - Not Accepted"),ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed - Not Accepted'))),
OR( ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED( AccountId ), ISCHANGED( Contact__c), ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISCHANGED( Probability ), ISCHANGED( Amount ), ISCHANGED( Type ), ISCHANGED( Category__c ), ISCHANGED( Freight_Shipping__c ), ISCHANGED( Freight_Frequency__c), ISCHANGED( Freight_Aircraft_Type__c), ISCHANGED( Description), ISCHANGED( Migrated__c), ISCHANGED( CloseDate))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: After an Opportunity is Closed, you may only edit the Closure Information section
